label: 4-port 802.3at gigabit PoE midspan (30W/port)
description: Rack/desk midspan that splices 802.3at power into four existing gigabit links, giving 30 W per port (120 W total) to APs, PTZ cameras and phones without replacing the switch. It sits between the switch and the devices and negotiates af/at per port, so passive-PoE gear will not come up on it.

poe.note: DERIVED, not quoted as a single total: the data sheet prints "Number of Ports 4", "Provides up to 30W per port for all ports" and the specifications row "Output Power 30W" (DS00003976B, read 2026-11-21), so the chassis total is 4 x 30 W = 120 W. Microchip publishes no "Total Output Power" line for the PD-9004G; the multiplication is the vendor's own "for all ports" claim, and it matches the 120 W already stated in this row's description.
